memory.interpretation: Native RSS includes cached compiled code. This is one short context and is not a maximum-capacity measurement. The cached code bytes and RSS are different measures; loaded graph resources were unloaded after each invocation.

power.battery_current_power_interpretation: Battery current during USB charging does not measure total phone power. No whole-device wattage is inferred.

conditional_tpu_rail_estimate.unit_interpretation: ABI-compatible inference: energy_value counters assumed µWs=µJ, timestamps/durations assumed ms. Exact installed CPM revision is unverified.
conditional_tpu_rail_estimate.limitations: Conditional conversion of two device-wide rail counters over the full cold run, much of which was CPU compilation. The installed CPM ABI is unverified, other NPU clients were present, other device rails are excluded, and this is not isolated model or steady-state NPU power.

sample_time_origin: Seconds relative to the first hardware sample; token events use the earlier process start as their separate origin.
